hypotheses.L1_larger_readable_grammar_matches_human: At least one 32- or 42-leaf grammar comes within 0.01 KL recovery of the human 21-category program.
hypotheses.L2_more_readable_variables_improve_behav: The best 42-leaf grammar exceeds the best 21-leaf grammar by at least 0.02 recovery.
hypotheses.L3_larger_readable_grammar_is_prediction: At least one 32- or 42-leaf grammar reaches 0.72 native top-1 agreement.
hypotheses.L4_grammar_stability_persists: Independent assignments have weighted NMI at least 0.80 at every tested leaf count.
hypotheses.L5_frontier_has_diminishing_returns: The recovery gain from 32 to 42 leaves is smaller than the gain from 21 to 32 leaves.
hypotheses.L6_readable_grammar_does_not_artificiall: No readable grammar exceeds human recovery by more than 0.03.
